subject: Urgent: forensic package delivery + delegated audit window for ApexBank
messages:
From: Diana Ross <diana.ross@apexbank.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@apexbank.com
Date: 2026-10-19T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: forensic package + short-notice audit window

Sergio,

Thanks for the call this morning. ApexBank legal needs a bundled forensic package for the minor auth anomaly we discussed (incident 2026-A2). We also need a short, delegated audit window next Wednesday (10/21) between 09:00-11:00 PT to validate logs and key rotation artifacts.

Deliverables we need from Redwood:
- Forensic manifest of artifacts (file hashes + explanations)
- Export of request/response HTTP logs (redacted PII) covering 10/12-10/18
- KV cache snapshot explanation and relevant entries for affected client IDs
- Proof of key-rotation events and KMS audit entries for 10/13

Can you confirm you can deliver a downloadable package and a read-only drive access link by EOD 10/20? Also let us know the Redwood SME to participate during the two-hour audit window.

Best,
Diana
Diana Ross
Head of Security Operations, ApexBank

--
Attachment: none (please send link)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Diana Ross <diana.ross@apexbank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: forensic package + short-notice audit window

Diana — thanks for the clear list. We can assemble the package but will need to coordinate a couple of items to keep the delivery auditable and scoped. Outline below:

1) Package contents & scope (we will redact PII and include proof of redaction):
   - forensic_manifest_v1.csv (artifact ids, SHA256, description)
   - http_request_response_export_10-12_to_10-18.csv.gz (PII redaction applied)
   - kv_cache_snapshot_relevant_keys.tar.gz (explanation of keys extracted)
   - kms_rotation_events_20261013.log (export of KMS audit entries)
   - readme: audit_evidence_readme.txt (how to interpret, data retention notes)

2) Delivery method: secure, time-limited Drive link + signed manifest. We can also provide an isolated S3 bucket with tokenized access if Apex prefers.

3) Audit participation: Laura Bennett (Security Ops) will join the delegated audit window; Ben Carter (IR lead) will be the primary for any forensic questions.

We can meet EOD 10/20 deadline if we start preparing now. Aditya will coordinate the export job cadence.

I will add the Redwood SME contact details and the scoped manifest in a follow-up within a few hours.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Sales (Enterprise) | Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: forensic package + short-notice audit window

Team — quick operational notes while we pull artifacts:

- I'll run the KMS audit extraction (timeline: 60–90m). Output will include request_id, principal, operation, and timestamp. We'll highlight rotation events for 10/13.
- Aditya: please queue the HTTP logs export with redaction rules (PII mask); mark entries for header/trailer retention. Use the export runner svc with job id EXPORT-9872.
- Ben: prepare a short investigation memo (one pager) that explains root-cause hypothesis and containment steps taken to date — Apex will expect this when we hand off.

I'll upload initial artifacts to a staging Drive folder and share a time-limited link. Need someone to sign the manifest (SLA/legal). Sergio, want me to create the Drive link with upload notes?

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Security Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Diana Ross <diana.ross@apexbank.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: forensic package + short-notice audit window

Hi all — export job kicked off (EXPORT-9872). ETA for logs export and initial manifest: ~6 hours. Notes below for transparency:

- Export config: redaction_rules_v3 (mask emails and account numbers), keep request/response latency and status codes.
- Sampling: full retention for 10/12–10/18 for the affected tenant IDs; aggregated-only for non-relevant tenants.
- KV snapshot: we will only include keys tied to the impacted client IDs; the snapshot will exclude long-lived secrets.

I will place the artifacts in a staging bucket and then Laura will move the final files to the Drive folder for Apex.

Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: [sandbox_kv_export.tar.gz (placeholder - upload pending)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-20T17:38:00-07:00

Files uploaded (manifests, logs redacted, export bundles):
- redwood_forensic_manifest_v1.csv (signed)
- http_request_response_export_10-12_to_10-18.csv.gz (PII redacted)
- kv_cache_snapshot_relevant_keys.tar.gz
- kms_rotation_events_20261013.log

Access: read-only Drive link (expires 10/27): https://drive.redwoodinternal.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cForensic_ApexBank (access granted to security@apexbank.com). We also posted a signed SHA256 manifest in the folder.

Audit participation: Laura Bennett (me) and Ben Carter will be available for the delegated audit on 2026-10-21, 09:00-11:00 PT. Please confirm whether Apex needs Zoom or if you will join via your own connectivity.

Notes: there is one low-level data mismatch in request IDs between the HTTP export and the KV snapshot due to backlog truncation on 10/15 — I've documented this in the readme.

—Laura

Apex participants: Mina Patel (forensics lead), security@apexbank.com, Diana Ross (SOps)
